name: synaps-dash
description: synaps·dash: a sleek browser client for the synaps session daemon. Attach to live sessions as a peer of the TUI, with an album-reactive MXC palette, smooth streaming and a full motion system.
author: Jawz

config.description: Loopback port for the synaps·dash web UI (default 7717).

Telemetry store + /api/telemetry/* (on|off). Unset = on for the default daemon, OFF for a profile daemon (sandbox, demo…); a profile needs telemetry = on in its own config. Reads local Synaps logs read-only; nothing leaves the machine.
Telemetry SQLite path. Unset = ~/.local/share/synaps-telemetry/telemetry.db (telemetry-<profile>.db for a profile daemon, which never uses the default daemon's DB).
Label for this machine's data in telemetry. Unset = the short hostname.
Extra read-only source roots, comma-separated host=path (e.g. jade=/path/to/snapshot). An entry named like telemetry_host replaces this daemon's own sources.
